scientific_integrity: Explicit analytic proof with exact spectral projectors, sharp polynomial sign analysis, checked rational examples, and qualified literature comparisons; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Connected simple noncomplete unweighted strongly regular graphs only; no assertion for general regular, directed or weighted networks.
Completed Gauss–Legendre rational end-step only; internal stages and repeated composition beyond per-step nonnegativity are not separately classified.
The finite rational computation is a reproduction check, not a proof of the universal statement.
Priority relative to unindexed association-scheme and numerical-analysis literature is not independently established.
title: A sharp Padé positivity horizon for strongly regular graph diffusion
